final_synthesis_description: All three stakeholders converged on a foster-to-adopt process-centered approach through breed-specific or general rescues as superior to the binary adopt/buy framing, prioritizing in-home compatibility assessment and reducing failed placements. The primary decision maker accepted with minor reservations, indicating the synthesis needs slight refinement to fully address legitimate owner needs alongside animal welfare.
remaining_disagreements: Extent to which the prospective owner's preference for specific traits or breeds should be weighted against rescue availability
Whether the synthesis sufficiently accounts for cases where foster-to-adopt infrastructure is locally unavailable or inadequate
Degree to which a failed adoption is framed as an ethical failure versus an expected systemic risk to be managed
